name: Hazro

queries.query: Hazro Pakistan official cadastral map parcel land record Attock Punjab
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Punjab PULSE/PLRA land-system portal, official ArcGIS cadastral-map service references, an Attock district land-use page listing MC Hazro maps, and an official district administration page describing land-record and registration duties. The public parcel service route was then inspected but required a token.

queries.query: حضرو پاکستان سرکاری اراضی ریکارڈ نقشہ کیڈسٹرل پنجاب
queries.result: Urdu-language discovery returned official Punjab land-record and Punjab government material, including PLRA/PULSE services and Hazro-specific official mapping references. No anonymous safe parcel-ID plus polygon response was exposed.

registryBasis: Official Punjab sources identify the Punjab Land Records Authority/PULSE land-record system and expose an Attock/Hazro cadastral-map scope. Official Attock district administration material describes maintenance and updating of periodical land records and registration records; official PMU-LGCDD material publishes an MC Hazro land-use map. This establishes relevant provincial/local administrative custody and mapped scope, not an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official PULSE map viewer states that it provides parcel maps linked to Punjab land records; its public interface says complete parcel details require login and includes a cadastral-map route.
Official Attock district planning page lists MC Hazro land-use classification and urban-block maps.
Official MC Hazro land-use classification map; planning/map evidence only, not a parcel-boundary dataset.
Official Attock district page describes maintenance and updating of periodical revenue/land records and registration-related records.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal for land-record services and service-center access.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; official viewer HTML retrieved and inspected. It references the public ArcGIS host and the Punjab cadastral map service; viewer text states complete parcel details require login.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab land-record/cadastral mapping with Attock and Hazro administrative/map references.

notes: Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order. No coordinate shift or exact-point hit/miss inference was used. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
